Why websites ask you to prove you're not a robot

A CAPTCHA is a challenge-response test that tries to tell humans and automated programs apart. Older versions showed distorted letters; newer ones such as reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha mostly watch how you move the mouse.

When a site shows a box that says "verify you are human", it is usually because the traffic from your network looks unusual. Shared VPN exits and office networks trigger these checks more often than home connections.

Sourdough bread depends on a living culture of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria. The starter is a simple mixture of flour and water, refreshed on a schedule so the microbes stay active and predictable.

Hydration is the ratio of water to flour by weight. A dough at seventy percent hydration is easy to shape, while doughs above eighty percent produce an open crumb but demand practice and gentle handling.

Bulk fermentation is where most of the flavour develops. Temperature matters more than the clock: at twenty-four degrees Celsius the dough may be ready in five hours, at twenty degrees it can take eight or more.

Stretch and fold sessions during the first two hours build strength without kneading. Wet your hands, lift one side of the dough, fold it over the middle, rotate the bowl and repeat until all four sides are done.

Shaping creates surface tension. A tight skin holds the gas produced during the final proof and lets the loaf rise upward in the oven instead of spreading into a flat disc.

Cold retarding in the refrigerator overnight slows the yeast while the bacteria keep producing acids. The result is a tangier loaf and a firmer dough that is easier to score cleanly.

Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at two hundred and fifty degrees with the lid on for twenty minutes, so the trapped steam keeps the crust soft while the loaf expands. Then remove the lid and bake until deeply browned.

Let the bread cool for at least an hour before slicing. The crumb is still setting as steam escapes, and cutting too early leaves it gummy.

Services like DataDome and Cloudflare sit in front of many large sites and decide, request by request, whether to show a challenge.
